title: Named genetics platforms are becoming a visible commercial layer above individual blueberry cultivars
rationale: Costa's 2026 BluGenix launch, Fall Creek's three-route commercial model including the closed SEKOYA platform, and United Exports' OZblu commercialization each place a named platform or brand between the breeding programme and individual cultivar denominations. The supported conclusion is that platform identity is now a material part of how several documented programmes are presented and accessed; the public record does not yet establish that growers choose platforms over cultivars or that commercial terms differ systematically, so this is not a claim that platform selling has replaced variety licensing.
